verdict.rationale: Omnara presents itself as an API-first product. Its docs say agents can be launched from the dashboard or programmatically through the CLI, REST API, or TypeScript SDK. A published OpenAPI spec is live, and API keys can hold the same org and project roles as users, which points to broad programmatic coverage. However, nothing explicitly claims full parity between the API and the UI. Some features are described only as dashboard actions (e.g., custom model endpoints), so 'everything' through the API is implied but not shown. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that dashboard-only settings (model endpoints, provider configuration) are reachable via API, and independent hands-on confirmation of API coverage.
